friendly_name: Eliminate Symfony-shaped behavior in Giiken ingestion + compilation CLI path
source_description: Remove Symfony fallback patterns (array callables, Symfony exception types, Symfony resolver/console coupling) from giiken:ingest:file → IngestionHandlerRegistry → file handlers → CompilationPipeline → persistence, aligning with Waaseyaa foundation contracts on waaseyaa/* ^0.1.0-alpha.174+. Out of scope: other Giiken console commands, HTTP upload validators, and third-party library uses (e.g. symfony/yaml in Markdown frontmatter) unless they introduce dispatch/resolver-shaped behavior.
